name: generic-single-plugin
description: The reference scenario: register the marketplace, install ONE plugin on a fresh box, and assert on the filesystem outcomes of the install -> bootstrap -> binstub -> plugin-load -> register flow. Name-free of any operator's repos; the plugin under test is fully configurable via CR_* env.

uv-index.purpose: On a governed box uv's default public PyPI index is TLS-blocked, so the deploy/provision stage fails (toolchain-uv jam). Mirrors the npm build-arg: opt-in only, default off so the jam surfaces.

stages.title: environment must look like a fresh machine
dependency chain (does one install pull the rest?)
runtime bootstrap on first session (venv + binstub)
binstub reachability from a stock login shell
register the current repo as a harness project
